statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s (f-g) ∧ KdVPlan.MemH s (f+g) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (f+g) ≤ KdVPlan.hn s f + KdVPlan.hn s g
proof:
intro s f g hf hg
rcases (h_T013.1 s f).mp hf with ⟨x, rfl⟩
rcases (h_T013.1 s g).mp hg with ⟨y, rfl⟩
have ha : KdVPlan.FromLP s x + KdVPlan.FromLP s y = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x+y) := by
  funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.FromLP, mul_add]
have hs : KdVPlan.FromLP s x - KdVPlan.FromLP s y = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x-y) := by
  funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.FromLP, mul_sub]
refine ⟨(h_T013.1 s _).mpr ⟨x-y, hs⟩, (h_T013.1 s _).mpr ⟨x+y, ha⟩, ?_⟩
rw [ha, h_T013.2.1, h_T013.2.1, h_T013.2.1]
exact norm_add_le x y
